materials_system.system_name: TPO 60 mil fully adhered with gypsum cover board (base); 80 mil + R-38 + MA (VE-5 option)
materials_system.insulation_spec: Polyiso R-30 two-layer staggered + gypsum cover board (base)

warranty_offered.certification_program: GAF Master Elite + Carlisle Master + Firestone Premier

references_provided.project_name: Amazon Fulfillment Centre YHM1, Hamilton (occupied, 185,000 sqft, VE saved $127k)
Magnotta Winery Expansion (92,000 sqft phased during harvest)
Prologis Park 407, Vaughan (145,000 sqft multi-building portfolio)
Apotex Pharmaceuticals, Toronto (78,000 sqft, temperature-sensitive — directly analogous)

technical_approach.narrative: 3-phase plan: office wing (1-18), main NW (19-52), main SE with ponding tapered (53-90). Max 10,000 sqft exposed. Bi-weekly coordination. Substantial completion 1 day before July 31 LD threshold.
technical_approach.weather_protection_plan: Daily watertight by 5PM; reinforced weighted tarps + secondary drainage
technical_approach.fall_protection_plan: COR certified, annual WAH refresh, dedicated safety coordinator for projects >75,000 sqft
technical_approach.waste_disposal_plan: Legal disposal; $3,500 hazmat testing allowance included

wsib.evidence: Clearance attached, WSIB rate 0.81 (well below 1.0 avg — strong safety record)

references.evidence: 4 occupied-building refs including Apotex (pharma temperature-sensitive — directly analogous) and Amazon YHM1. Fully satisfies RFP §5.1.

manufacturer_certification.evidence: GAF Master Elite (top 2%) + Carlisle Master + Firestone Premier

warranty_minimum.evidence: 20-yr NDL meets min; 2-yr workmanship meets min (can upgrade to 5-yr for $8,500)

cover_board.evidence: Gypsum cover board included in base bid

red_flags.description: Base workmanship 2 years meets min but lags Summit (5 yr) and Pinnacle (3 yr). $8,500 upgrade to 5-yr available as negotiation item

VE-5 suggests removing cover board on MA system — manufacturer-acceptable but departs from RFP spec. Owner must decide whether VE-5 is accepted (saves $8k; upgrades membrane + insulation) or base bid preserved.
red_flags.citation: RFP §3.2 cover board requirement + fixture 02 §4 MA-system manufacturer variance
red_flags.recommendation: clarify — owner elects base or VE-5 at contract formation

red_flags.description: Substantial completion July 30 leaves 1 day margin before $500/day LD trigger July 31. Typical risk factor but no contingency buffer in schedule.
red_flags.recommendation: accept-with-condition — include weather/unforeseen-condition extension protocol in contract
